subject: Budget range validation & procurement path — NightWatch AI
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya@nightwatch.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + ask: monthly spend band & procurement threshold

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and a couple of clarifying asks so we can finalize a tailored pricing proposal and SOW: 

Recap from our discovery
- Estimated inference volume: 40M-60M tokens / month initially, with burst patterns up to 120M in campaign windows.
- Primary workload: short-form assistant responses (~ avg 45 tokens/generation) + embeddings for search index refresh (daily).
- Desired SLA & security: 99.9% uptime, SOC2 in procurement, VPC peering later in year.

Pricing & budget context you shared
- Target unit economics: you mentioned aiming for ~$900–$1,200 per 1M tokens as a target range to hit your internal ROI thresholds.
- Procurement threshold: procurement needs purchase orders for any recurring commitment > $50k / month and a separate legal review for deals > $250k / year.

Asks from our side to finalize banding (can you confirm the two items below?):
1) Confirm the monthly committed spend band you expect in year-1 (choose the closest): 0–25k, 25k–75k, 75k–150k, 150k–300k.
2) Confirm who in procurement should review the SOW/Order Form and whether PO or SAP/Ariba will be used.

Next steps from Redwood (attached):
- I’ve attached a draft SOW (NightWatch_SOW_draft.pdf) and a token consumption workbook (token_estimates.xlsx) with a few pricing scenarios mapped to your 40/60/120M token profiles.
- If you confirm the monthly band and procurement contact, we’ll return a formal quote with two options: a committed discounted tier (term + commit) and a flexible pay-as-you-go path for pilot months.

If easier, we can jump on a 20-min call with procurement this week — happy to coordinate.

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0194

Attachments: NightWatch_SOW_draft.pdf (5 pages), token_estimates.xlsx (workbook)

From: Priya Shah <priya@nightwatch.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + ask: monthly spend band & procurement threshold

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks for the summary and the materials — helpful. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

1) Monthly band: based on the roadmap and our Q1 campaigns we expect to start in the 75k–150k / month band (likely closer to the low end initially). We do have a third-quarter marketing push that could push monthly volume higher for 6–8 weeks.

2) Procurement: please loop in our procurement lead, Amit Rao (amit.rao@nightwatch.ai). For deals with an annual commitment > $200k they require a PO and legal review; anything above $50k / month also needs a PO and a Finance sign-off. We use Coupa for purchase orders.

3) Unit economics: the internal target is nearer $1,000 per 1M tokens for production workloads —but there is some flexibility if we get committed discounts and predictable latency SLOs.

Can you return a range with committed vs. flexible pricing for the 75k–150k band and a separate line for the campaign-burst scenario? Also, is SOC2 evidence available for the hosted product or would that only be for a dedicated/private deployment?

Best,

Priya Shah
Head of Product, NightWatch AI
priya@nightwatch.ai

Kim —

Quick internal suggestion based on Priya’s note: propose two discrete options:

Option A (Committed):
- 12-month term, monthly committed spend tier 75k–150k.
- Unit price target: $850–$950 per 1M tokens (sliding scale based on commit level).
- Includes prefix caching recommendations and 2 weeks of integration support.
- Procurement: countersign + PO via Coupa.

Option B (Pilot / Flexible):
- Month-to-month for first 3 months, pay-as-you-go with burst credits.
- Unit price: $1,050 per 1M tokens with optional 10% credit for predictable monthly min.
- No term lock; ideal while they ramp.

Also suggest we surface SOC2 Type II evidence and the Hosted product controls in the email — reduces back-and-forth. I’ll pull the SOC2 artifact and a short controls matrix (attach) if you want to include it.

Rishi
Director, Sales Engineering

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya@nightwatch.ai>, Amit Rao <amit.rao@nightwatch.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: NightWatch pricing ranges + procurement path (SOW attached)

Hi Priya / Amit —

Following up with the two formalized pricing bands and next steps. Rishi and I reviewed your estimates and aligned on a proposal that maps to the volumes you called out. SOW attached for procurement intake.

Summary of options (for 75k–150k monthly profile):
- Committed (recommended if you want predictable unit economics): $900 per 1M tokens (flat) with a 12-month term and monthly minimum at the 75k band. Upgrades in commit (e.g., hitting sustained 150k/mo) move unit price to $850 per 1M tokens.
- Flexible (pilot): $1,050 per 1M tokens, month-to-month, no term; includes 10% burst-credit top-up for campaign months for the first 3 months.

Campaign-burst scenario (one-off peaks to ~120M tokens for 6–8 weeks):
- Committed customers: automatic burst capacity at discounted add-on rate of $700 per 1M tokens for the burst period (must be pre-notified 72 hours ahead).
- Flexible customers: burst capacity billed at $1,200 per 1M tokens.

Procurement path & thresholds
- For annual commitment > $200k or monthly spend > $50k a PO via Coupa is required.
- Attached SOW includes standard terms; we can route a redline-friendly Order Form to your legal team.
- I’ve included the SOC2 Type II evidence link in the Drive folder for procurement review.

Next steps
1) Amit — can you confirm Coupa PO process and expected lead time for PO generation? Also please confirm the procurement contact if it’s yourself or someone else.
2) Priya — confirm which option you prefer (Committed vs Flexible) and whether you’d like us to prepare a DocuSign Order Form for signature.
3) We will hold the quoted committed pricing for 10 business days from today.

DocuSign preview: https://www.docusign.com/DocuSign/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abc-123

Best,
